messages:
anya: Heads-up — StellarPay console shows tokens/sec at 0 for ~30m. Customer reports slow UX and missing activity on dashboard. Backend ingestion and logs look normal on our side. Can someone triage? :eyes:
ops-bot: alert: console.metrics.missing customer=stellarpay rule=tokens_sec gap=30m ts=1718754250 (auto-notify)
sanjay: Any recent deploys to the streaming rollup/aggregator? Could be a windowing edge-case.
lee: I rolled streaming-aggregator v2.1.3 at 1718754200 with a fast-windowing optimization. Looking now. I can try to repro.
rachel: Quick check: raw event counts for customer=stellarpay in the raw topic are non-zero. Ran a quick ksql query, results show steady requests in the last 20m. So ingestion is fine — probably rollup/aggregation or checkpointing.
anya: Console screenshots show a series of negative deltas earlier, then zeros. Sample log snippet from console backend: ```WARN rollup-worker: computed delta=-14 for window 2026-03-17T10:02:00Z, clamping disabled```
sanjay: That negative delta then a clamp-to-zero bug would explain the flattened metric. Can you share the rollup logs and the worker checkpoint state?
lee: Repro steps I used locally: boot a rollup-worker with --window-size=60s and --enable-fast-rollup, start load for customer=stellarpay, then restart the consumer mid-window. After restart I reproduce zeros for 2–3 windows. Steps: ```# reproduce
export CUSTOMER=stellarpay
kafka-consumer --topic tokens_raw --group rollup-test --reset-offset latest &
./rollup-worker --window-size=60 --enable-fast-rollup --customer $CUSTOMER
# restart the consumer while load ongoing
kill -9 $(pidof kafka-consumer); sleep 5; kafka-consumer --topic tokens_raw --group rollup-test &```
rachel: Workaround to fix prod now: restart rollup-worker with checkpoint reset for affected partitions and replay raw events for the window range. Command I ran: ```kafka-tools replay --topic tokens_raw --from 1718754000 --to 1718755300 --key customer:stellarpay``` — backfill restored tokens/sec on the console within ~2 minutes.
anya: Customer billing is also impacted — console zeros triggered an underbilling alert for their dashboard usage. Billing flagged this as a support escal. We need a short-term mitigation (don't write 0 when windows missing) and a long-term fix.
sanjay: Proposal: patch rollup-worker to 1) emit null/absent for missing windows instead of 0, 2) clamp negative deltas to 0 before aggregation but mark as anomalous, and 3) add a consumer-restart grace-window to avoid writing incomplete windows.
lee: I'm opening a patch PR to change the write-path behavior (emit NULL + anomaly tag) and add an ephemeral replay on worker start. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/rollup/PR/542 (internal). Planning hotfix deploy.
ops-bot: deploy-request: user=lee action=hotfix-rollup branch=hotfix/emit-null started_at=1718755300
lee: Hotfix deployed to prod at 1718755325, rolling restart of rollup-workers done. Monitoring: tokens/sec for StellarPay resumed to expected non-zero values and billing signals cleared.
sanjay: Thanks — please follow up with a short postmortem (root cause, mitigation, follow-ups) and ping billing & customer success to confirm the customer is made whole. :thumbsup:
anya: Filing incident ticket and adding repro steps + backfill commands to the ticket. Closing thread once postmortem is published.
